purpose: Define runtime capabilities as explicit machine-readable identities describing what a component/operation can technically do, separate from authorization to do it.

topics.name: Capability Identity
topics.purpose: Define runtime capabilities as explicit machine-readable identities describing what a component/operation can technically do, separate from authorization to do it.

semantics.identity_rule: Each capability has an explicit identity.
semantics.subject_rule: Capability may bind exact component/tool/backend/operation implementation.
semantics.availability_rule: Capability may be available/unavailable at runtime without changing its semantic identity.
semantics.authorization_rule: Capability means technical ability only and never caller authorization.
semantics.advertisement_rule: Advertised capability is descriptive claim until validated/accepted.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

references.purpose: MCP advertisements map to validated capabilities.
